$Classic Controller
*By Vague Rant and quatric
*Cars (Europe: Fr, Nl) (RCAX78)
*Play with a Classic Controller (or Pro): left stick steers, ZL / the C-stick jumps.
*Needs a Wii Remote with a Classic Controller attached.
* Classic Controller patch

$GameCube controller
*By quatric
*Cars (Europe: Fr, Nl) (RCAX78)
*Play with a GameCube controller in ports 1-4, with or without a Wii Remote.
*Needs the Classic Controller code above as well: enable both.
* KPADRead entry: keep the GameCube ports probed and polled

$Skip pitstop motions
*By Vague Rant
*Cars (Europe: Fr, Nl) (RCAX78)
*The Piston Cup pitstop minigames count their motion prompts as done.
*Needed to finish the game with a Classic Controller or GameCube pad.
* Skip pitstop motions
04062CAC 4800001C
$Widescreen fix
*By Vague Rant
*Cars (Europe: Fr, Nl) (RCAX78)
*With the console set to 16:9, show more to the sides (hor+) instead of
*cropping the top and bottom of the 4:3 view (vert-).
* Widescreen fix (hor+) hook
